question: Which source pages can prove each frozen Goal question without treating a convenient page as the brand representative?
procedure: Start from the frozen Goal and list the intended visual roles: identity, campaign, task, content and interaction.
For every role, record the canonical or prominent page and any task-specific page; a task page cannot silently replace a canonical page.
Record page purpose, visible region, viewport, state and availability before extracting values.
If a source is unavailable, preserve its intended role and record the replacement as a bounded source, not as equivalent brand authority.
notFor: Promoting a task button into a global CTA
